summary: BASTION_ENABLED=false smoke test — call served by Sera (Intake) but no session ingested by Bastion, as expected. Confirms the kill-switch is wired and decoupled from the audio path; if Bastion were to lose backend, Sera (Intake) would keep answering patient calls and only the observability layer would degrade. Why: HIPAA §164.312(c)(2) integrity controls require care operations to continue independently of monitoring infrastructure — non-negotiable for HIPAA Security Rule attestation.
